title: Mixed Event — Special Present for You! — Episode6 Let's Make Lanterns!

meta.Event Outline: Rui has received a request to write and direct a ski resort's Christmas show. This is the first script he's penned in some time, and it's apparently based on a Christmas episode from his own childhood...

rows.Line: Ski Resort - Vacant Room

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so great that we get to be a part of the show!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Yeah, it's gotta be our lucky day!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kamishiro!
I got a bunch of milk cartons and plastic bottles from the cafeteria!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The prop master even said that we could use as much of this tape as we want to decorate them☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You and the others have gathered quite a lot of people, Tsukasa. We should be able to make plenty of lanterns now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, you really took us by surprise when you said that we can ask the guests for help by turning our show into an interactive one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I realized this was our only way of producing the effect in question without our equipment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want us to make lanterns by hand...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We can recreate the effect that way?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, my original plan for the climax was to create a path of light by having the lanterns set up in a straight line along the slope.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our Santa Clauses would ski down and greet the children waiting for them at the bottom.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we have no lanterns or launching devices on hand at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I thought that we could work together to become that path.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're gonna become the path?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, by lining up along the slope while holding our lanterns.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, then we'd be able to use your original idea without having to change much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But how are we gonna make our lanterns?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's actually very simple, provided we get our hands on some milk cartons and plastic bottles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All you have to do is cut out a few shapes, make some decorations using tape and origami, and stick them on. It's a remarkably quick process.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
That sounds like a lot of fun☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
But I doubt we'll be able to make enough by ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
We alone won't be able to make enough lanterns to turn that slope into a fitting path of light.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why we're going to need the help of others to make it happen. So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking about asking the guests.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The climax will be an interactive scene where we ask them to stand on the slope while holding their own lanterns.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By doing so, they'll get to become a part of the path of light while fully immersing themselves within the show's story.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That certainly would be a unique experience...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Plus, it'll be our chance to get people who didn't have any plans to see the show to come and watch!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, Rui, let's do this...!
We're going to work together and make it an unforgettable scene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Between recruiting people and gathering supplies, we have quite a lot to do. So, let's start by dividing up the work...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Excuse me. I'm here to make lanterns for the show. Am I in the right place?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Yes, please feel free to wait inside. We'll be starting shortly!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad more people gathered than we were initially expecting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We really need to thank you and the others for helping gather all these people, Azusawa. You've done a remarkable job...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I'm just glad that we could help all of you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We went around the slopes to see if any of the skiers would like to help out. Quite a few of them showed interest when they heard that they'd get to be a part of the show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Looks like Rui was right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A lot of children said that they wanted to be in a show with Santa Claus.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, after hearing that, even more people decided to volunteer...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now we really need to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. But we're also short on time, so why don't we get started?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, then...
Let's start making our lanterns.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All done☆ What do you guys think?!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, your lantern's really cute!
It's got so many stars on it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I stuck on lots and lots so that it shines like crazy when we light it!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Cool! I wanna put stars on mine too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, lemme cut some out for you guys!
We can make our lanterns sparkly and wonderhoy together♪

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here, I finished cutting it...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would you mind helping with this little one's bottle next, Shinonome? I was asked to cut a sawtooth pattern at the bottom...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A sawtooth pattern? Another tough request...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, you guys! Come over here to decorate your bottles once he's finished cutting them for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can stick on all the shapes you want using whatever tape you like!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya, excellent work!
From every angle, this looks like it's smack-dab in the center!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only that, you've succeeded in cutting this tape into a perfect triangle.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, that's amazing!
How did you cut these out like this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
These?
It's actually very easy if you draw on your shapes and patterns before going to cut them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't we all give it a try together?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
There we are...
Okay, I think we've finished sticking everything on...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hello! How are the lanterns coming along?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, Luka.
An and I are just about done with ours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All that's left for mine is to stick some music note stickers on the milk carton!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Wow, both of your lanterns look so cute!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But they're completely different from each other. They seem like wonderful expressions of your personalities.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our personalities?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <For instance, An stuck a few big stickers onto hers, while you used many small ones to create a larger pattern!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, now that you mention it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. This looks like a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know. I'll try asking MEIKO to see if we can make these over in SEKAI sometime♪>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we can all make some together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's up, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Umm, we're out of tape.
I'll go get a new roll!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, see you in a bit!
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Everyone's lanterns seem to be coming along nicely...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Dad, it's so hard to cut out a perfect circle...

rows.Speaker: Parent A
rows.Line: Oh, in this case, you'll want to rotate the paper instead of your scissors.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Wow, Mom, your decorations look so amazing! How did you do that?!

rows.Speaker: Parent B
rows.Line: I did this by placing stickers in different ways depending on their size.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our volunteers seem to be enjoying themselves very much.)
se_walk_women_005_2

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? Azusawa?
Have you already finished making your lanterns?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We're nearly finished.
But we ran out of tape, so I came to get a new roll.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We put a lot of effort into them, and I think they're going to turn out really well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was really worried when I heard about what happened, but I'm glad that you'll still get to do your show...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and I have everyone here to thank.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Including you and the others, Azusawa. I can't thank you all enough.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, we couldn't pass this opportunity up. It's not every day that you get to be a part of a show like this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I'm really looking forward to seeing it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (All these people are looking forward to seeing our show...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For their sake, we need to make certain that it's a good one...)
